falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout to new highs would invalidate the 75% bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows and consolidation; this would signal the 'HOLD' was wrong and a new uptrend leg had begun instead

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX would contradict the BLOWOFF SCORE of 40, which implies elevated volatility/uncertainty; this would prove the market had already de-risked and the bottoming pattern was not in progress

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid of this magnitude would signal recession panic rather than the controlled bottoming implied by the pattern match; this would invalidate the 'HOLD' by showing the market was repricing to a much worse macro outcome than the August 2024 analogue

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
